plain_text:
Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Bill Thompson is credited on 376 distinct recordings across 8 programs from 1935-12-16 through 1956-09-14. Documented roles include performer on 376 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Fibber McGee and Molly (performer on 363 recordings; 363 distinct recordings), The Phil Harris-Alice Faye Show (performer on 5 recordings; 5 distinct recordings), CBS Radio Workshop (performer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), Wild Bill Hickok (performer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), Lux Radio Theatre (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), The Great Gildersleeve (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), The Halls of Ivy (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), and The Lone Ranger (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).

Documented character portrayals include Wallace Wimple (9 portrayals) and The Old Timer (6 portrayals).
